name: application-autocomplete-address-field
title: Autocomplete Address Field
description: A single street-address input with a live suggestion dropdown, plus the structured street/city/state/ZIP fill-out state after a suggestion is chosen.
useWhen: Collecting a mailing or billing address where typeahead suggestions from a geocoding API reduce typos and typing effort.
The form ultimately needs structured street/city/state/ZIP fields, pre-filled from a selected suggestion but still user-editable.
avoidWhen: The list of options is small and closed (not an open-ended address lookup) — use `Combobox` instead.
You only need free-text address entry with no lookup or structured breakdown — a plain `Textarea` is simpler.
responsiveBehavior: The suggestion dropdown matches the input's full width and stacks below it; the structured fill-out fields wrap city/state into a two-column row that can collapse to one column on narrow viewports.
accessibility: The input uses role="combobox" with aria-expanded, aria-controls, and aria-autocomplete="list" to describe its relationship to the suggestion list.
The suggestion list uses role="listbox"/role="option" with aria-selected marking the highlighted suggestion.
After autofill, a checkmark plus visible helper text ("Filled from address lookup — edit any field if needed") communicates the field is editable, not locked.

variants.title: Suggestion dropdown
variants.description: A street-address input mid-search with an open suggestion list; each option shows the street line and a secondary city/state/ZIP line.
accessibility: role="combobox" on the input and role="listbox"/role="option" on the suggestions form a standard ARIA autocomplete pattern.

variants.title: Suggestion dropdown (Dark)
variants.description: Suggestion dropdown adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Suggestion text and the selected-row highlight meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark dropdown background.

variants.title: Structured fill-out
variants.description: The resulting structured form after a suggestion is chosen: street, optional unit, city, state, and ZIP, each still editable.
accessibility: A visible checkmark plus footer text states the fields were auto-filled and remain editable, not just an icon.

variants.title: Structured fill-out (Dark)
variants.description: Structured fill-out fields adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Field borders, autofilled background tint, and the confirmation checkmark meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.
